source.note: Scan without a text layer. National Senior Certificate paper (cover: NATIONAL SENIOR CERTIFICATE; running header: NSC). The PDF includes the cover (printed page 1), the instructions (page 2) and the information sheet (page 10); PDF page n = printed page n. The cover states that the question paper consists of 9 pages and 1 information sheet. Duration 3 hours as printed on the cover. Source file and hash are recorded in sources/maths/manifest.json.

extraction.method: manual transcription from 170 dpi page renders, checked at 400 dpi where needed

questions.text_md: Calculate the value(s) of $x$.

questions.stem_md: Rectangles of width $1$ cm are drawn from the edge of a sheet of paper that is $30$ cm long such that there is a $1$ cm gap between one rectangle and the next. The length of the first rectangle is $21$ cm and the length of each successive rectangle is $85\%$ of the length of the previous rectangle until there are rectangles drawn along the entire length of $\mathrm{AD}$. Each rectangle is coloured grey.

questions.text_md: Calculate the length of the $10^{\text{th}}$ rectangle.
Calculate the percentage of the paper that is coloured grey.

questions.stem_md:
Sketched below is the graph of $h(x)=a^{x}$, $a>0$. $\mathrm{R}$ is the $y$-intercept of $h$.
The points $\mathrm{P}(2\,;\,9)$ and $\mathrm{Q}\left(b\,;\,\dfrac{1}{81}\right)$ lie on $h$.

questions.text_md: Write down the equation of the asymptote of $h$.
Determine the coordinates of $\mathrm{R}$.
Calculate the value of $a$.
$\mathrm{D}$ is a point such that $\mathrm{DQ}\parallel y$-axis and $\mathrm{DP}\parallel x$-axis. Calculate the length of $\mathrm{DP}$.
Determine the values of $k$ for which the equation $h(x+2)+k=0$ will have a root that is less than $-6$.

questions.stem_md:
Sketched below is the parabola $f$, with equation $f(x)=-x^{2}+4x-3$ and a hyperbola $g$, with equation $(x-p)(y+t)=3$.

- $\mathrm{B}$, the turning point of $f$, lies at the point of intersection of the asymptotes of $g$.
- $\mathrm{A}(-1\,;\,0)$ is the $x$-intercept of $g$.

questions.text_md: Show that the coordinates of $\mathrm{B}$ are $(2\,;\,1)$
Write down the range of $f$.
For which value(s) of $x$ will $g(x)\geq 0$?
Determine the equation of the vertical asymptote of the graph of $h$ if $h(x)=g(x+4)$
Determine the values of $p$ and $t$.
Write down the values of $x$ for which $f(x)\cdot g'(x)\geq 0$
questions.notes: Sign of the product of f and the derivative of the hyperbola g. Closest existing skills tagged.

questions.text_md: On the same set of axes, sketch the graphs of $f$ and $g$, clearly showing ALL intercepts with the axes.
Write down the equation of $g^{-1}(x)$, the inverse of $g$, in the form $y=\ldots$
Explain how you will use QUESTION 6.1 and/or QUESTION 6.2 to solve the equation $\log_{2}(3-x)=x$.
Write down the solution to $\log_{2}(3-x)=x$.

questions.stem_md: On $1$ June $2016$ a bank granted Thabiso a loan of $\mathrm{R}250\,000$ at an interest rate of $15\%$ p.a. compounded monthly, to buy a car. Thabiso agreed to repay the loan in monthly instalments commencing on $1$ July $2016$ and ending $4$ years later on $1$ June $2020$. However, Thabiso was unable to make the first two instalments and only commenced with the monthly instalments on $1$ September $2016$.

questions.text_md: Calculate the amount Thabiso owed the bank on $1$ August $2016$, a month before he paid his first monthly instalment.
Having paid the first monthly instalment on $1$ September $2016$, Thabiso will still pay his last monthly instalment on $1$ June $2020$. Calculate his monthly instalment.
If Thabiso paid $\mathrm{R}9\,000$ as his monthly instalment starting on $1$ September $2016$, how many months sooner will he repay the loan?
If Thabiso paid $\mathrm{R}9\,000$ as a monthly instalment starting on $1$ September $2016$, calculate the final instalment to repay the loan.
Determine $f'(x)$ from first principles if $f(x)=3x^{2}$

John determines $g'(a)$, the derivative of a certain function $g$ at $x=a$, and arrives at the answer:  $\displaystyle\lim_{h\to 0}\dfrac{\sqrt{4+h}-2}{h}$
Write down the equation of $g$ and the value of $a$.
Determine $\dfrac{dy}{dx}$ if $y=\sqrt{x^{3}}-\dfrac{5}{x^{3}}$
questions.notes: Notation confirmed at 400 dpi: radicand is x³ only; the second term is 5/x³.

questions.text_md: $g(x)=-8x+20$ is a tangent to $f(x)=x^{3}+ax^{2}+bx+18$ at $x=1$. Calculate the values of $a$ and $b$.

questions.stem_md: For a certain function $f$, the first derivative is given as $f'(x)=3x^{2}+8x-3$

questions.text_md: Calculate the $x$-coordinates of the stationary points of $f$.
For which values of $x$ is $f$ concave down?
Determine the values of $x$ for which $f$ is strictly increasing.
If it is further given that $f(x)=ax^{3}+bx^{2}+cx+d$ and $f(0)=-18$, determine the equation of $f$.

questions.stem_md: The number of molecules of a certain drug in the bloodstream $t$ hours after it has been taken is represented by the equation $\mathrm{M}(t)=-t^{3}+3t^{2}+72t$, $0<t<10$.

questions.text_md: Determine the number of molecules of the drug in the bloodstream $3$ hours after the drug was taken.
Determine the rate at which the number of molecules of the drug in the bloodstream is changing at exactly $2$ hours after the drug was taken.
How many hours after taking the drug will the rate at which the number of molecules of the drug in the bloodstream is changing, be a maximum?
